content:
nora: Quick heads-up: onboarding Zephyr-7B int4 flagged a reproducible drop on our summarization canary after quant. Short thread.

nora: fp16 ppl 11.7 -> int4 12.4; summarization length -30% and ROUGE down ~6.

raj: paste conversion + quant flags please.

nora: conversion: NFKC normalize, preserved ids where possible but merged rare control chars. quant flags: `per_channel=true, symmetric=false, clip=99.9, calib_batches=200`.

tasha: Zephyr checkpoint note: q/k/v proj stored in an interleaved head layout (head0_comp0, head1_comp0, ...). If loader assumes block layout you end up shuffling components and rotary sees wrong phases.

nora: quick local test: swapped loader to de-interleave q/k/v -> block order and re-ran 50-sample canary. ppl -> 11.9, ROUGE recovered ~+4.5 and outputs stop cutting off.

raj: also check tokenizer id collisions from the normalization change (soft-hyphen and zwj variants). That breaks prefix cache semantics for long contexts.

nora: ran tokenmap dedupe check: found 2 collapsed ids after NFKC. Fixing mapping gave a small further quality bump.

ci-bot: ci job queued: zephyr/onboard/triage/1819999999 (calib + loader-permute + tokenmap-smoke). ETA ~8m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tasha: action items: 1) add auto-detect heuristic for proj layout (check `proj_layout` metadata, shapes, fallback two-way smoke ppl); 2) conversion-time tokenmap collision warning and dedupe option; 3) add summarization canary to int4 onboard smoke.

raj: Ill add a tokenmap histogram check to the loader and a small unit test for interleaved->block permute.

nora: opened PR with loader permute + tokenmap check + test, assigning to @raj for review.

raj: will review after lunch, nice triage :thumbsup:
